catalyst.name: Cornered, Incandescent, Jötunn Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants the Cornered trait: Grants 15% decreased Charge/Draw Time while within 15 meters of 2 enemies. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once no longer surrounded.
Grants the Incandescent trait: Weapon Kills trigger a Solar explosion that applies 30 Scorch Stacks (40 with Ember of Ashes) and deals up to 30 damage to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

damage.note: Clarity's tick (46) on Quantum's scale: Quantum's 932 stands for Clarity's 1 184 + 269 of the projectile, so 29.5 per tick (Quantum's tab Weapon Specifics: 30 per tick; Aegis 97 / 3.31 = 29.3)

delayMs.note: the first tick one interval after the impact, seconds to milliseconds

count.note: duration divided by the interval: 7 ticks

source.name: Item file j-tunn
source.quote: detonates on impact and creates a burning pool of fire
source.note: Derived: the boss stands in the pool of every shot; pools of successive shots tick side by side (Clarity says nothing else). Aegis "successive shots" counts about 4 ticks per shot (1 048 - 930 = 118 / 29.3), known-inaccuracies W6c

notModelled.quote: This is reduced to 0% damage at the edge of the radius
notModelled.reason: no falloff on a direct hit: inside Quantum's value of the projectile
